purpose: Verify BR-VH-002: VHMS shall restrict billing responsibility values to Visitor, Indenter, Institute, or Project..
preconditions: A booking requisition records billing responsibility.
action_or_input: Submit otherwise valid booking requests using Visitor, Indenter, Institute, and Project; then submit one unsupported value.
expected_result: The four listed values are accepted; a value outside that set is refused.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-003: VHMS shall apply the same approval routing to offline bookings as to other booking requests..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: An offline booking is recorded. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Use the same approval routing as other booking requests.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-004: VHMS shall apply the same room-availability checking to offline bookings as to other booking requests..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: An offline booking is processed. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Use the same room-availability checking as other booking requests.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-005: VHMS shall clearly flag offline bookings for audit and reporting..
preconditions: A booking is recorded from a telephonic or walk-in request.
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A booking is recorded from a telephonic or walk-in request. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Persist an Offline designation for audit/reporting.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-006: VHMS shall compute cancellation charges according to the stated cancellation charge schedule..
preconditions: A cancellation/no-show charge must be determined.
action_or_input: Request cancellations exactly 7 days before arrival, within 7 days excluding same-day, and on the same day; inspect each charge.
expected_result: Charges follow the complete stated schedule: 0%, 25% of one-day room rent, and 50% of one-day room rent for the respective cases.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-007: For a cancellation occurring exactly 7 days before arrival, VHMS shall apply no cancellation charge..
preconditions: Cancellation occurs exactly 7 days before arrival.
action_or_input: Request cancellation exactly 7 days before arrival and inspect the charge.
expected_result: The cancellation charge is zero.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-008: For a cancellation within 7 days before arrival, excluding the separately stated same-day case, VHMS shall apply 25% of one-day room rent..
preconditions: Cancellation occurs within 7 days before arrival and is not same-day.
action_or_input: Request cancellation within 7 days, excluding same-day, and inspect the charge.
expected_result: The charge is 25% of one-day room rent.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-009: For a same-day cancellation or a recorded no-show, VHMS shall apply 50% of one-day room rent..
action_or_input: Request same-day cancellation and inspect the charge; separately inspect the stated no-show charge case.
expected_result: The charge is 50% of one-day room rent for same-day cancellation/no-show.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-010: VHMS shall adjust billing information according to the confirmed modification outcome..
preconditions: A modification outcome has been confirmed.
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A modification outcome has been confirmed. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Adjust billing information according to the confirmed modification outcome.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-011: VHMS shall adjust billing information according to the confirmed cancellation outcome and applicable cancellation charge..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A cancellation is confirmed. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Adjust billing using the confirmed cancellation outcome and applicable charge.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-012: VHMS shall allow rooms to be allotted only after booking approval..
action_or_input: Attempt allotment for a booking before approval and again after approval.
expected_result: Allotment is refused before approval and permitted only after approval.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-013: VHMS shall support Single occupancy records..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: Occupancy type is recorded. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Single is a supported occupancy value.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-014: VHMS shall support Double occupancy records..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: Occupancy type is recorded. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Double is a supported occupancy value.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-015: VHMS shall support Suite room records..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: Room type is recorded. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Suite is a supported room-type value.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-016: VHMS shall support Non-suite room records..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: Room type is recorded. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Non-suite is a supported room-type value.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-017: When an expected guest has not checked in under the recorded stay timing, VHMS shall generate a no-show alert..
preconditions: Expected check-in has not occurred under recorded timing.
action_or_input: Allow the specified check-in deadline to pass without a recorded check-in; inspect alert records.
expected_result: A no-show alert is generated for the guest who did not check in.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-018: When a recorded stay exceeds the approved duration, VHMS shall generate an overstay alert..
action_or_input: Allow the approved stay duration to end without a recorded check-out; inspect alert records.
expected_result: An overstay alert is generated after the approved duration.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-019: Visitor category values used by VHMS shall be A, B, C, or D according to institute norms represented/configured in VHMS..
action_or_input: Classify visitors using the represented institute norms for categories A, B, C, and D.
expected_result: Each visitor is assigned the category determined by the represented norm.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-023: During billing, VHMS shall select the applicable tariff using the recorded visitor category, occupancy, and effective-from tariff information..
action_or_input: Generate bills for category/occupancy combinations with effective tariffs, including a changeover date.
expected_result: The bill uses the applicable recorded category, occupancy, and effective-date tariff.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-024: VHMS shall prevent tariff changes from affecting historical bills already generated or finalized in VHMS..
preconditions: Tariff configuration changes after a bill has been generated/finalized.
action_or_input: Generate/finalize a bill, change its tariff configuration, then retrieve the historical bill.
expected_result: The tariff update does not change the previously generated/finalized bill.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-025: Meal bookings shall be recorded only for guests staying in VH..
action_or_input: Book a meal for a guest with an active VH stay and attempt the same for a guest without a VH stay.
expected_result: Meal booking is allowed for the staying guest; it is refused for a guest without a VH stay.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-029: VHMS shall restrict individual meal options to Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner..
action_or_input: Submit meal bookings for each permitted option (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner), then one option outside that set.
expected_result: The permitted options are accepted and an outside option is refused: Allowed values: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-030: VHMS shall restrict add-on options to Tea and Milk..
action_or_input: Submit meal bookings for each permitted option (Tea, Milk), then one option outside that set.
expected_result: The permitted options are accepted and an outside option is refused: Allowed values: Tea, Milk.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-031: A meal booking shall be linked to the guest's recorded stay duration..
action_or_input: Create a meal booking inside the stay period and another outside it; inspect stay linkage.
expected_result: The in-period meal is linked to the stay; the out-of-period meal is not linked.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-032: Recorded meal bookings shall be included in VHMS billing..
preconditions: A bill is generated for a stay with meal bookings.
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A bill is generated for a stay with meal bookings. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Include recorded meal bookings in billing.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-033: VHMS shall generate bills based on room rent..
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A bill is generated. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Include room-rent component.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-034: VHMS shall generate bills based on meal consumption..
preconditions: A bill is generated and meal consumption exists.
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A bill is generated and meal consumption exists. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Include meal-consumption component.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-035: VHMS shall generate bills based on applicable cancellation charges..
preconditions: A bill is generated and an applicable cancellation/no-show charge exists.
action_or_input: When this condition occurs: A bill is generated and an applicable cancellation/no-show charge exists. Perform the specified VHMS action and inspect its recorded outcome.
expected_result: Include the applicable cancellation-charge component.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-036: VHMS shall record settlement as an offline cash settlement; online payment processing is not performed by VHMS..
action_or_input: Record a cash settlement offline and inspect the bill record; do not initiate an online payment.
expected_result: The settlement is recorded as offline cash; no online payment processing is performed.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-037: VHMS shall maintain immutable billing records for audit..
action_or_input: Generate/finalize a bill, attempt to alter it, then retrieve it for audit.
expected_result: The bill remains immutable for audit.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-041: When current inventory quantity falls below the recorded minimum threshold, VHMS shall generate an inventory threshold alert..
action_or_input: Set inventory quantity below, equal to, and above its recorded minimum threshold; inspect alert records.
expected_result: An alert is recorded below threshold; none is generated when quantity is equal to or above it.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-043: An inventory threshold alert shall trigger the corresponding VHMS system-generated email notification event..
action_or_input: Cause an inventory threshold alert and inspect the generated notification event/record.
expected_result: VHMS triggers the system-generated email notification for the inventory threshold alert.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-045: VHMS shall maintain exactly one active Caretaker at a time..
action_or_input: Create one active Caretaker assignment, then attempt a second overlapping active assignment.
expected_result: Exactly one active Caretaker assignment is maintained at a time.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-046: VHMS shall maintain exactly one active VH In-Charge at a time..
action_or_input: Create one active VH In-Charge assignment, then attempt a second overlapping active assignment.
expected_result: Exactly one active VH In-Charge assignment is maintained at a time.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-047: VHMS Caretaker and VH In-Charge role assignments shall be time-bound..
action_or_input: Create a role assignment with a start and end time; inspect assignment activity within and outside its period.
expected_result: The VHMS role assignment is bounded by its recorded effective period.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-048: A VHMS operational role reassignment shall take effect immediately..
action_or_input: Reassign the VHMS role and immediately inspect access/active assignment for the new role holder.
expected_result: The reassignment is applied immediately.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-049: VHMS shall transfer pending records to the newly assigned role holder after role reassignment..
action_or_input: Reassign the role while pending records exist; inspect assignment of those records to the new holder.
expected_result: The pending records are transferred to the newly assigned role holder.

purpose: Verify BR-VH-050: VHMS shall transfer ongoing records to the newly assigned role holder after role reassignment..
action_or_input: Reassign the role while ongoing records exist; inspect assignment of those records to the new holder.
expected_result: The ongoing records are transferred to the newly assigned role holder.
